The primary material of a candle is typically wax.

Regarding the operational processes at AutoBuild, the centralization of tools and materials is creating a significant bottleneck. The requirement for workers to travel long distances across the site to retrieve items is causing lost productivity due to excessive transit time. To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing resources by establishing smaller, localized tool and material stations closer to specific construction areas. This would reduce non-value-added travel time and allow workers to focus more on their primary tasks.
